opening.argument: The video presents CoinPro as an income opportunity built on recurring rewards and referral expansion. The speaker says it will provide “everyday Free Coins,” directs viewers to a referral link and Facebook group, and urges them to “make the community or make the network to sustain yourself.” The displayed account reinforces that structure: it instructs members to refer friends and shows percentage-based earnings across multiple levels, including 7.5% and 16.5%. The supplied description likewise provides a USI-TECH sponsor ID and direct referral link, tying the promotion to participation through referrals and tiered rewards.
